in_marathi.name: Midhuna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Midhuna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of rivers and fertility, often associated with the goddess Ganga. In Hindu mythology, she is believed to protect and nourish life, bringing prosperity and abundance.

in_bengali.name: Midhuna
